description_for_human: Search and discover 850+ AI tools across all categories.
description_for_model: Search the Great Library AI directory of 850+ AI SaaS tools. Use the API at /api/tools with query parameters ?q= for search, ?category= for filtering. Each tool has name, description, pricing (free/freemium/paid/open-source), rating, category, tags, and URL. Categories: chatbots, image-generation, writing, coding, video, audio, productivity, research, design, marketing.
